verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs describe graph memory as built automatically "without you defining any schema". Nothing in the pack shows a way to define custom entity types, edge types, or a domain ontology. The customizable Pydantic schemas apply only to memory export, which is a separate feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain
